name: Warm Shrimp Salad with Mixed Veggies, Avocado & Lemon Caper Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
2 medium zucchini squash
2 avocados
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals (if using fresh shrimp, skip this step). Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a small bowl. Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard stems, mince the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Finely chop the anchovy fillets. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, oil, Dijon, and salt; whisk to combine dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
½ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp capers
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Dijon mustard
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; place both in a large bowl and set aside.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Trim zucchini, halve lengthwise, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peas, zucchini, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Remove peas and zucchini to the bowl with the tomatoes. Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shrimp, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until cooked through and slightly golden, about 4 minutes; remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates; top with shrimp, vegetables, avocado, and dressing. Enjoy!

ingredients.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
